vsm2.17:250.1: Tattha bhavatīti bhavo. So kammabhavo upapattibhavo cāti duvidho hoti.
vsm2.17:250.2: Yathāha – ‘‘bhavo duvidhena atthi kammabhavo, atthi upapattibhavo’’ti (vibha. 234).
vsm2.17:250.3: Tattha kammameva bhavo kammabhavo, tathā upapattiyeva bhavo upapattibhavo.
vsm2.17:250.5: Kammaṃ pana yathā sukhakāraṇattā ‘‘sukho buddhānaṃ uppādo’’ti (dha. pa. 194) vutto,
vsm2.17:251.1: 647.Dhammato pana kammabhavo tāva saṅkhepato cetanā ceva cetanāsampayuttā ca abhijjhādayo kammasaṅkhātā dhammā.
vsm2.17:251.2: Yathāha – ‘‘tattha katamo kammabhavo? Puññābhisaṅkhāro apuññābhisaṅkhāro āneñjābhisaṅkhāro (vibha. 234) parittabhūmako vā mahābhūmako vā, ayaṃ vuccati kammabhavo.
vsm2.17:252.1: Ettha hi puññābhisaṅkhāroti terasa cetanā. Apuññābhisaṅkhāroti dvādasa. Āneñjābhisaṅkhāroti catasso cetanā.
vsm2.17:252.2: Evaṃ parittabhūmako vā mahābhūmako vāti etena tāsaṃyeva cetanānaṃ mandabahuvipākatā vuttā.
vsm2.17:252.3: Sabbampi bhavagāmikammanti iminā pana cetanāsampayuttā abhijjhādayo vuttā.
vsm2.17:253.1: Upapattibhavo pana saṅkhepato kammābhinibbattā khandhā, pabhedato navavidho hoti.
vsm2.17:253.2: Yathāha – ‘‘tattha katamo upapattibhavo? Kāmabhavo rūpabhavo arūpabhavo saññābhavo asaññābhavo nevasaññānāsaññābhavo, ekavokārabhavo catuvokārabhavo pañcavokārabhavo, ayaṃ vuccati upapattibhavo’’ti (vibha. 234).
vsm2.17:254.1: Tattha kāmasaṅkhāto bhavo kāmabhavo. Esa nayo rūpārūpabhavesu.
vsm2.17:254.2: Saññāvataṃ bhavo, saññā vā ettha bhave atthīti saññābhavo. Vipariyāyena asaññābhavo.
vsm2.17:254.3: Oḷārikāya saññāya abhāvā sukhumāya ca bhāvā nevasaññā, nāsaññā asmiṃ bhaveti nevasaññānāsaññābhavo.
vsm2.17:254.4: Ekena rūpakkhandhena vokiṇṇo bhavo ekavokārabhavo. Eko vā vokāro assa bhavassāti ekavokārabhavo.
vsm2.17:255.1: Tattha kāmabhavo pañca upādiṇṇakkhandhā. Tathā rūpabhavo. Arūpabhavo cattāro, saññābhavo pañca.
vsm2.17:255.3: Ekavokārabhavādayo ekacatupañcakkhandhā upādiṇṇakkhandhehīti evamettha dhammatopi viññātabbo vinicchayo.
vsm2.17:256.1: 648.Sātthatoti yathā ca bhavaniddese, tatheva kāmaṃ saṅkhāraniddesepi puññābhisaṅkhārādayova vuttā,
vsm2.17:256.2: evaṃ santepi purime atītakammavasena idha paṭisandhiyā paccayattā, ime paccuppannakammavasena āyatiṃ paṭisandhiyā paccayattāti punavacanaṃ sātthakameva,
vsm2.17:256.3: pubbe vā ‘‘tattha katamo puññābhisaṅkhāro? Kusalā cetanā kāmāvacarā’’ti (vibha. 226) evamādinā nayena cetanāva saṅkhārāti vuttā.
vsm2.17:257.1: Kiṃ vā bahunā, ‘‘avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā’’ti ettha puññābhisaṅkhārādayova kusalākusalā dhammā vuttā.
vsm2.17:257.2: ‘‘Upādānapaccayā bhavo’’ti idha pana upapattibhavassāpi saṅgahitattā kusalākusalābyākatā dhammā vuttā.
vsm2.17:257.3: Tasmā sabbathāpi sātthakamevidaṃ punavacananti evamettha sātthatopi viññātabbo vinicchayo.
vsm2.17:258.1: 649.Bhedasaṅgahāti upādānapaccayā bhavassa bhedato ceva saṅgahato ca.
vsm2.17:258.2: Yañhi kāmupādānapaccayā kāmabhavanibbattakaṃ kammaṃ karīyati, so kammabhavo.
vsm2.17:258.3: Tadabhinibbattā khandhā upapattibhavo. Esa nayo rūpārūpabhavesu.
vsm2.17:258.4: Evaṃ kāmupādānapaccayā dve kāmabhavā, tadantogadhā ca saññābhavapañcavokārabhavā,
vsm2.17:258.6: dve arūpabhavā, tadantogadhā ca saññābhavanevasaññānāsaññābhavacatuvokārabhavāti saddhiṃ antogadhehi cha bhavā.
vsm2.17:258.7: Yathā ca kāmupādānapaccayā saddhiṃ antogadhehi cha bhavā. Tathā sesupādānapaccayāpīti
vsm2.17:258.8: evaṃ upādānapaccayā bhedato saddhiṃ antogadhehi catuvīsati bhavā.
vsm2.17:259.1: Saṅgahato pana kammabhavaṃ upapattibhavañca ekato katvā kāmupādānapaccayā saddhiṃ antogadhehi eko kāmabhavo.
vsm2.17:259.2: Tathā rūpārūpabhavāti tayo bhavā. Tathā sesupādānapaccayā pīti.
vsm2.17:259.3: Evaṃ upādānapaccayā saṅgahato saddhiṃ antogadhehi dvādasa bhavā.
vsm2.17:260.1: Apica avisesena upādānapaccayā kāmabhavūpagaṃ kammaṃ kammabhavo.
vsm2.17:260.2: Tadabhinibbattā khandhā upapattibhavo. Esa nayo rūpārūpabhavesu.
vsm2.17:260.3: Evaṃ upādānapaccayā saddhiṃ antogadhehi dve kāmabhavā, dve rūpabhavā, dve arūpabhavāti aparena pariyāyena saṅgahato cha bhavā.
vsm2.17:260.4: Kammabhavaupapattibhavabhedaṃ vā anupagamma saddhiṃ antogadhehi kāmabhavādivasena tayo bhavā honti.
vsm2.17:260.5: Kāmabhavādibhedampi anupagamma kammabhavaupapattibhavavasena dve bhavā honti.
vsm2.17:260.6: Kammupapattibhedañcāpi anupagamma upādānapaccayā bhavoti bhavavasena ekova bhavo hotīti
vsm2.17:260.7: evamettha upādānapaccayassa bhavassa bhedasaṅgahāpi viññātabbo vinicchayo.
vsm2.17:261.1: 650.Yaṃ yassa paccayo cevāti yañcettha upādānaṃ yassa paccayo hoti, tatopi viññātabbo vinicchayoti attho.
vsm2.17:261.5: So idaṃ yuttaṃ idaṃ ayuttanti avicāretvā yassa kassaci upādānassa vasena yaṃkiñci bhavaṃ patthetvā yaṃkiñci kammaṃ karotiyeva.
vsm2.17:261.6: Tasmā yadekacce sīlabbatupādānena rūpārūpabhavā na hontīti vadanti, taṃ na gahetabbaṃ.
vsm2.17:262.1: Seyyathidaṃ – idhekacco anussavavasena vā diṭṭhānusārena vā ‘‘kāmā nāmete manussaloke ceva khattiyamahāsālakulādīsu, cha kāmāvacaradevaloke ca samiddhā’’ti cintetvā
vsm2.17:262.2: tesaṃ adhigamatthaṃ asaddhammassavanādīhi vañcito ‘‘iminā kammena kāmā sampajjantī’’ti maññamāno kāmupādānavasena kāyaduccaritādīnipi karoti,
vsm2.17:262.4: Sandiṭṭhike vā pana kāme patthayamāno paṭiladdhe ca gopayamāno kāmupādānavasena kāyaduccaritādīni karoti,
vsm2.17:262.6: Tatrāssa upapattihetubhūtaṃ kammaṃ kammabhavo. Kammābhinibbattā khandhā upapattibhavo.
vsm2.17:263.1: Aparo pana saddhammassavanādīhi upabrūhitañāṇo ‘‘iminā kammena kāmā sampajjantī’’ti maññamāno kāmupādānavasena kāyasucaritādīni karoti.
vsm2.17:263.2: So sucaritapāripūriyā devesu vā manussesu vā upapajjati.
vsm2.17:263.3: Tatrāssa upapattihetubhūtaṃ kammaṃ kammabhavo. Kammābhinibbattā khandhā upapattibhavo.
vsm2.17:263.5: Iti kāmupādānaṃ sappabhedassa sāntogadhassa kāmabhavassa paccayo hoti.
vsm2.17:264.1: Aparo ‘‘rūpārūpabhavesu tato samiddhatarā kāmā’’ti sutvā parikappetvā vā kāmupādānavaseneva rūpārūpasamāpattiyo nibbattetvā samāpattibalena rūpārūpabrahmaloke upapajjati.
vsm2.17:264.2: Tatrāssa upapattihetubhūtaṃ kammaṃ kammabhavo. Kammābhinibbattā khandhā upapattibhavo.
vsm2.17:264.4: Iti kāmupādānaṃ sappabhedānaṃ sāntogadhānaṃ rūpārūpabhavānampi paccayo hoti.
vsm2.17:265.1: Aparo ‘‘ayaṃ attā nāma kāmāvacarasampattibhave vā rūpārūpabhavānaṃ vā aññatarasmiṃ ucchinne suucchinno hotī’’ti ucchedadiṭṭhiṃ upādāya tadupagaṃ kammaṃ karoti,
vsm2.17:265.3: Kammābhinibbattā khandhā upapattibhavo. Saññābhavādayo pana tadantogadhā eva.
vsm2.17:265.4: Iti diṭṭhupādānaṃ sappabhedānaṃ sāntogadhānaṃ tiṇṇampi kāmarūpārūpabhavānaṃ paccayo hoti.
vsm2.17:266.1: Aparo ‘‘ayaṃ attā nāma kāmāvacarasampattibhave vā rūpārūpabhavānaṃ vā aññatarasmiṃ sukhī hoti vigatapariḷāho’’ti attavādupādānena tadupagaṃ kammaṃ karoti,
vsm2.17:266.3: Tadabhinibbattā khandhā upapattibhavo. Saññābhavādayo pana tadantogadhā eva.
vsm2.17:266.4: Iti attavādupādānaṃ sappabhedānaṃ sāntogadhānaṃ tiṇṇaṃ bhavānaṃ paccayo hoti.
vsm2.17:267.1: Aparo ‘‘idaṃ sīlabbataṃ nāma kāmāvacarasampattibhave vā rūpārūpabhavānaṃ vā aññatarasmiṃ paripūrentassa sukhaṃ pāripūriṃ gacchatī’’ti sīlabbatupādānavasena tadupagaṃ kammaṃ karoti,
vsm2.17:267.3: Tadabhinibbattā khandhā upapattibhavo. Saññābhavādayo pana tadantogadhā eva.
vsm2.17:267.4: Iti sīlabbatupādānaṃ sappabhedānaṃ sāntogadhānaṃ tiṇṇaṃ bhavānaṃ paccayo hoti.
vsm2.17:267.5: Evamettha yaṃ yassa paccayo hoti, tatopi viññātabbo vinicchayo.
vsm2.17:268.1: Kiṃ panettha kassa bhavassa kathaṃ paccayo hotīti ce?
vsm2.17:268.2:
Rūpārūpabhavānaṃ, upanissayapaccayo upādānaṃ;
Sahajātādīhipi taṃ, kāmabhavassāti viññeyyaṃ.
vsm2.17:269.1: Rūpārūpabhavānaṃ hi, kāmabhavapariyāpannassa ca kammabhave kusalakammasseva,
vsm2.17:269.2: upapattibhavassa cetaṃ catubbidhampi upādānaṃ upanissayapaccayavasena ekadhāva paccayo hoti.
vsm2.17:269.3: Kāmabhave attanā sampayuttākusalakammabhavassa sahajātaaññamaññanissayasampayuttaatthiavigatahetupaccayappabhedehi sahajātādīhi paccayo hoti.
vsm2.17:270.1: 651. Bhavapaccayā jātītiādīsu jātiādīnaṃ vinicchayo saccaniddese vuttanayeneva veditabbo.
vsm2.17:270.3: So hi jātiyā paccayo, na upapattibhavo.
vsm2.17:270.4: So ca pana kammapaccayaupanissayapaccayavasena dvedhā paccayo hotīti.
vsm2.17:271.1: Tattha siyā – kathaṃ panetaṃ jānitabbaṃ bhavo jātiyā paccayoti ce?
vsm2.17:271.3: Bāhirānaṃ hi janakajananīsukkasoṇitāhārādīnaṃ paccayānaṃ samattepi sattānaṃ yamakānampi sataṃ hīnapaṇītatādiviseso dissati.
vsm2.17:271.4: So ca na ahetuko sabbadā ca sabbesañca abhāvato,
vsm2.17:271.5: na kammabhavato aññahetuko tadabhinibbattakasattānaṃ ajjhattasantāne aññassa kāraṇassa abhāvatoti kammabhavahetukova.
vsm2.17:271.7: Tenāha bhagavā ‘‘kammaṃ satte vibhajati yadidaṃ hīnappaṇītatāyā’’ti (ma. ni. 3.289).
vsm2.17:272.1: Yasmā ca asati jātiyā jarāmaraṇaṃ nāma, sokādayo vā dhammā na honti.
vsm2.17:272.2: Jātiyā pana sati jarāmaraṇañceva, jarāmaraṇasaṅkhātadukkhadhammaphuṭṭhassa ca bālajanassa jarāmaraṇābhisambandhā vā tena tena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa anabhisambandhā vā sokādayo ca dhammā honti.
vsm2.17:272.3: Tasmā ayampi jāti jarāmaraṇassa ceva sokādīnañca paccayo hotīti veditabbā.
vsm2.17:272.4: Sā pana upanissayakoṭiyā ekadhāva paccayo hotīti.
